The Bid Award Panel adopted the following: 1. Bid Award Panel grant authority to award the contract in accordance with the Contract Details set out in the report (July 19, 2018) from the Chief Purchasing Officer: Call Number: Request for Quotation No. 3717-18-5023 Description: The non-exclusive supply of landscape maintenance services for the City of Toronto's Beautiful Streets Unit, Public Realm Section, Transportation Services Division. Scope includes traffic control, weeding, litter pick up/debris removal, sod cutting, and maintenance of plant materials. Supply, delivery and installation of plant material, sod, seed, growing medium, mulch, and watering services may also be required.
